title: Build the organization maps library
goal: Provide an organization-wide site-map library with filters, canonical scoped creation, builder deep links, and duplicate-surface consolidation.

evidence: Maps is now an organization library with Library/Draft/Published/Archived views, search/sort, canonical creation scope, and siteMapId deep links into the existing builder.

progress.summary: Organization Maps library is integrated and uses the ADMIN-003 acting-context and scoped-creation contract.
completed: Organization library loads without event/tour scope.
Creation and image import remain disabled until canonical scope is selected.
Event entry points reuse the authoritative library and builder.
next_steps: Verify blank and image-backed persistence in an authenticated browser session.

checkpoints.summary: Integrated the organization-wide Maps library and status navigation without changing the server authorization boundary.
checkpoints.next: Complete authenticated builder persistence regression under QA-007.
